notes: NEW Ethereum mainnet UNLOCK/UNLK launch; this is a technical manifest, not deployment approval or policy configuration. Source: https://github.com/identity-md-launches/launch-1838-uniswap-v4-hook-code at 3b29fd1d044fb16bbe1595ddacf7ec4efbfdd8fa, with accepted adaptations preserved. Archived import/payment evidence in docs/mainnet/release/network binds repoUrl/baseCommit and identifies payer/owner as 0x48e4e74fe1d0c14404ceb57b9fec5b21329c6ec9; revalidate actual release records. Existing Sepolia deployment is preserved; no website publication. UnlkImdHook has four constructor words in the listed order and ten permissions (0x3fcc). Both initialization callbacks are PoolManager-only; beforeInitialize accepts only the launch factory and binds the sorted UNLK/IMD PoolKey once at fee12500, spacing60. Factory creates UnlkToken, enforcing hook and native distributor, initializes the pool and locks seed principal. Fixed 1B supply, 18 decimals, minted once to factory; policy allocates 10% swarm/87% pool/3% payer with seed rounding. The required nominal initialPrice is 1:1; factory opening price derives from the policy's 2500 IMD whole-supply cap and actual token ordering. Collected LP fees split 80% payer/20% IMD distribution (1%/0.25% at zero core protocol fee); core protocol fees can increase effective trade fees without stopping swaps or gates. Extra fixed 75bps of executed IMD accrues as IMD claims to the immutable treasury beneficiary, the same named wallet. NFT buying remains manual; no automated purchases or burns. Stateless ImdSpotUsdSource: UNLK/USD = official UNLK/IMD spot * verified existing IMD/native-ETH spot * validated Chainlink ETH/USD; FDV uses fixed 1B supply. Chain/code, PoolKey, currency/decimal, liquidity and feed-freshness checks remain. No sample(), keeper, observation windows, recurring recording transactions or warm-up. Invalid references withhold only new gates after activation; otherwise valid trading, ordinary transfers and native claims independent of synchronization remain available. Quota=max(0,floor(matureE*p/10000)-S); standard Universal Router initiator accounting, one-block buy maturity and cumulative E/S preserve prior sales: 1000 acquired, 200 sold at20%, then30% permits only100 more. Initial20%; USD FDV gates100K:25%,250K:30%,500K:35%,1M:40%,2M:45%,3.5M:50%,5M:55%,7.5M:60%,10M:65%,15M:70%,20M:75%,25M:80%,30M:85%,35M:90%,40M:95%;50M permanently bypasses quotas for ALL holders. A valid touch observed after a swap or at checkpoint opens the highest crossed gate permanently, without confirmation or relocking. Accepted risks remain disclosed/tested: mature shared-executor quota pooling and manipulation of either pool, including same-transaction/flash external reference manipulation, can open all gates permanently; these are not fixed. Stage1 alone means pool deployed/trading inactive. Before broadcast, establish the supported factory release service and executable owner-signed stage2, re-mine flags/salt against final initcode and real addresses, and rehearse the actual native round0 tree. Owner calls deployPriceSource for ImdSpotUsdSource, deployCompanions, tree certification, then configureAndActivate atomically with valid current price. Setup then seals; no upgrades, pauses, resets, exemptions or later rule changes. PrepareOwnerTransactions supplies wallet envelopes once real release identities/tree are available. Release record reports missing protected harness, pending mandatory platform panel, publication/attestation and actual release inputs; supplemental reviews and fork simulations are not deployment evidence. No new mainnet addresses, transactions, PoolId, explorer verification or sealed-setup evidence are claimed. See docs/mainnet/SPOT_PRICE.md and docs/mainnet/release/STATUS.json.
